    for word in words:

fhand.close()

import string

out = open('poem-l6.txt', 'w')
out.write('Love is patient, love is kind.\n')
out.write('Love is not envy; love never fails.\n')
out.close()

counts = dict()
fhand = open('poem-l6.txt')
for line in fhand:
    line = line.translate(str.maketrans('', '', string.punctuation))
    line = line.lower()
    for word in line.split():
        counts[word] = counts.get(word, 0) + 1
fhand.close()
print('unique words: %d' % len(counts))
best = None
best_word = None
for word in counts:
    if best is None or counts[word] > best:
        best = counts[word]
        best_word = word
print('top word: %s (%d)' % (best_word, best))

import string

text = 'Go now! Go, go! NOW, go.'
clean = text.translate(str.maketrans('', '', string.punctuation)).lower()
counts = dict()
for word in clean.split():
    counts[word] = counts.get(word, 0) + 1
print(counts)
best = None
best_word = None
for word in counts:
    if best is None or counts[word] > best:
        best = counts[word]
        best_word = word
print('top:', best_word, best)
